symptom: Production supervisor reported raw active=6, provider zombies=9 and effective active=0 even though live Actions still had executable work.
root_cause: Provider-zombie discovery used paginated status-specific scans while raw active pressure used only the first unpaginated 100 recent runs. The deduction and raw census therefore described different universes.
fix: Count queued, in_progress, pending, waiting and requested with fully paginated status-specific queries before subtracting only provider zombies observed in that same active universe.
prevention: Any capacity metric that subtracts exclusions must derive numerator and exclusions from the same paginated population; regression tests enforce the workflow implementation.
